help.title: Controls
help.body:
WASD / arrows — walk (Shift — run) · click ground — go there
Drag mouse — rotate camera · wheel — zoom
Space — "Khööe!": nearby animals bunch and move away from you
U — hold/put away the herding stick. With it animals shy away from you
F — mount / dismount · H — call horse
Q — scare wolves (45 m, 60 m mounted). Wolves attack unprotected animals inside their territory (red ring)
Z — protection zones: pen, tent, herder (15 m, 20 m mounted), dog (10 m), stallion (15 m)
K — dog orders (follow me, stay here, patrol here, patrol camp, guard herd) · N — all dogs follow me
M — move camp: staying long degrades pasture and grass regrows slower
Herds go to water and new pasture on their own: together when far from water, one by one when near
Walk over milk/wool to collect (10 units), store it near the tent · E — pick up / store
B — storage & processing · T — prepare goods to sell at the sum center · V — get in/out of a cart or truck
1 / 2 / 3 — speed 1× 2× 4× · G — pasture heatmap · F1 — help · ` — cheat menu
Night: in the evening animals walk home by themselves (sheep into the pen, cows beside it) and sleep. Animals too far away sleep where they are. In the morning they leave milk and wool where they slept — the amount depends on how well they grazed the day before. At night a wolf may come to the camp and attack animals sleeping outside it. 
Sum center (M4.6): ride your horse (F) or get in a cart/truck (V, drive with WASD) to the edge of the camp to open the world map. Tab — jump straight to the world map (mounts your horse if on foot). Click where to go on the map (you can change it while travelling). At the sum center press E at the Merchant (yellow ring) to trade. T at camp: take goods from storage into your hands (10 units), load/unload the cart or truck. You start without a cart — buy one from the Merchant. Animals bought on horseback follow you home (slowly).
Helpers (M5): at the sum center Teahouse (blue ring) press E to hire a herder family or a single helper. J — helpers: herd a flock (sheep & goats / cattle / horses), drive goods to the sum center, take animals on otor to another camp (needs a spare tent — get a ger or buy an otor tent), pay with animals, dismiss. Children collect milk and wool into storage. Buy helper tents/gers and otor tents from the Merchant.
Seasons (M5.5): 1 year = 50 days (summer → autumn → winter → spring). Camps: River bend (summer), Mountain flank (summer, autumn; buried in snow in winter), South slope (warm shed, snow melts fast — winter), North slope (forest, warm shed, snow lingers and keeps grass underneath — spring). Snow covers grass. Animals sleeping outside in winter lose condition — not inside a shed pen. Buy hay bales from the Merchant: in winter/spring hungry animals are fed automatically at your camp. Most young are born in spring, none in winter. Visit an otor camp on the world map to collect its milk and wool.
help.touch: Touch controls 🕹 Bottom-left joystick — walk (push to the edge to run), drive 👆 Tap the ground — go there, double-tap to run · ☝️ drag — rotate camera · ✌️ pinch — zoom 📣 Shout · 🐺 scare wolves · ✋ pick up/store · 🪵 hold uurga · 🐎 mount/dismount · 🐴 call horse · 🚚 enter vehicle · 🗺 world map · ⏩ hold on the map to fast-forward Top menu: 📦 storage · 🧺 cargo · 🏕 camps · 👥 helpers · 🐕 dogs · 🛡 zones · 1× speed · ⛶ fullscreen Tap the top-left panel for details.

menu.diff.hint: ×1 = balanced. Wolves ×0 = no attacks · "No" = wolves scare and scatter animals but never catch them · Time ×2 = days pass twice as fast. Can be changed mid-game.

intro.0.title: A call from home
intro.0.text: Your grandparents are too old to herd now. They called you, in the city, back to the steppe.
intro.1.title: Grandfather's herd
intro.1.text: 10 sheep, 2 cows, a riding horse and a small 4-wall ger — all yours now. Your grandparents will advise you by phone.
intro.2.title: Four seasons
intro.2.text: Milk and wool in summer, preparing in autumn, cold winters, lambs in spring. Feed the herd, guard it from wolves, earn your place.
